title: The AI coach knows how many workouts the member did this week, but not the member's own weekly goal
what: A member can set a goal of workouts a week, and the Workout tab, the week cards and the home-screen widget all use it. The coach's snapshot of the member's day sends this week's workout count but leaves the goal out, so asked 'am I training enough?' the coach cannot say '2 of your 4' and may judge the week against its own idea of enough.
expected: The coach's snapshot carries the member's weekly goal (or that none is set) next to this week's count.
who: members who set a weekly goal and use the AI coach
how_often: every open coaching question about the week
fix_line: Add the weekly goal to what the coach is told about the member's week

title: Every member starts on the male body figure, and only Profile ever asks
what: The muscle map on the finish screen, the workout page and the shared workout picture draw a male or female figure. The app has no sex field and never asks during setup or before the first share, so every woman sees, and posts, a male figure until she finds 'Body figure' inside Profile.
expected: The figure is asked at a natural moment (setup, the first finish screen or the first share), or the picture offers the choice right there.
how_often: every workout finished and shared until changed
fix_line: Ask for the body figure once, at setup or on the first share picture

evidence: data:Crispy Curves gym row and counts, 26 Nov 2026 query (name yes, logo no, 2 plans, 0 wods, 0 measures, 2 app members)
items.reason: Gym plans on the phone need check-in phone (1 of 2 filled), roster phone (2/2) and plan dates (1/1). Crispy Curves query: gym name set, no logo (picture falls back to name), 2 plans, 0 workouts of the day, 0 body measurements, 2 app members.
Body figure is asked only in Profile; check-in phone is asked by the gym join screens outside this area.
No feature here depends on a field most Crispy Curves rows lack (check-in phone 1 of 2 is half, not most).

No mobile number or typed date box here (date is tapped on a calendar). Measures box fed '72,5' ok, ' 72.5 ' ok, '72 kg', Devanagari or Arabic digits and '1,234.5' refused with the box named (not cut silently); digit-only keypad. Folder and routine names: spaces folded, cut at 60.
No box cuts a real autofill; the measures box refuses pasted units or other-script digits openly with its name.
